elements.manual_reason: Cursor ends on the Fields button whose box (b01) is used for the button's hover state; cursor needs its own box.
elements.label: Mouse cursor
Table rows and Effort header hover highlights

pattern.description: The cursor sweeps up diagonally across the idea table, briefly highlighting rows and the Effort column header, and lands on the Fields toolbar button on the word 'fields'.
pattern.why_premium: Cursor arrival is synced to the narration ('based on these fields'), so the pointer acts as a visual citation of the word being spoken without any added overlay.

build_hint.gsap: Recorded UI. To recreate: gsap.to('.cursor', {x: -170, y: -480, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out'}); timeline callbacks toggle row/header hover classes as the cursor crosses them; at the end gsap.set('.fields-btn', {className: '+=is-hover'}).
build_hint.remotion: Cursor x/y = interpolate(frame, [0, 16], [start, end], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); row and header hover states derived from cursor position each frame; Fields button hover when cursor is inside its rect.

notes: b02 reports changed_share 0 on the end frame; the row hovers are transient during the sweep. Fields button hover is subtle (cursor change to hand plus faint tint).
